title: What the Rain Keeps
poem: i.  The mirror agrees with me, mostly. It is the mostly I keep.
ii.  They tell me the rain is only weather. Then why does it knock to be let in.
iii.  I keep an inventory of tendernesses meant for someone else.
iv.  Somewhere a door I did not close is still open. I feel its draft in my hands.
v.  Each morning I assemble the same face and hope it holds till dark.
colophon: a skyline that blinks back; each refresh, a city that never was.
